text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yes! Now I'm a real runner!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on your debut, City! It
was a
fantastic run!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
The fans are all wondering about your
future!
What kind of agenda do you
have in mind?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Will you set your eyes on the G1 races?
The
Hanshin Juvenile Fillies, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
The glamor of the race would suit you!
Plus it's an
important one leading up to
the Tiara tour!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ah—just one last thing! Your fans are
eager to see
more of your eye-catching
running!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days after Gold City's successful
debut, I
call her over to decide her next
goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Asahi Hai F.S. tends to attract
runners aiming
for the Classic Triple
Crown tour, while the
Hanshin J.F. is for
the Tiara tour.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Both the Classic Triple Crown and Triple
Tiara are
top class series.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
As a real runner... that's the kind of glory
I have
to strive for.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I think... the Hanshin J.F. might suit me
best.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It seems like my fans really want to see
me wear
the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Tiara consists of the Oka Sho,

Japanese Oaks, and Shuka Sho—three
races
famed for their glamorous
spectacle.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It's like that reporter said, everyone's
looking for
an eye-catching performance
from me, aren't
they?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, I should give them
what they
want!
